product_summary: AI social listening and media monitoring platform tracking brand mentions across social, news, blogs, forums, podcasts and reviews, with sentiment, reach analytics, reporting, and a REST API for mentions and insights.
current_data_sources: Social platforms (Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Twitch, Bluesky)

api_or_integration_evidence.quote: 25M+ online sources monitored – social media, news, blogs, forums, podcasts, review platforms & more
Simple REST integration with X-Api-Key authentication, consistent JSON responses
The API is available as a $99/month add-on on the Business plan and included on Enterprise.

newsletter_capability_detail: Brand24 documents newsletter monitoring as a self-serve feature where a user adds a newsletter URL in account settings, so newsletter coverage exists but appears to be per-project, user-initiated rather than a broad indexed newsletter corpus.

evidence.quote: You’ll see a form where you can enter your own, or any other, newsletter to monitor!
25M+ online sources monitored – social media, news, blogs, forums, podcasts, review platforms & more
Gather insights from 25 million online sources, tracked in real-time.

likely_buyer_role: Head of Product/CPO or Head of Data & Integrations for the listening platform
caveats: Claimed gap is disconfirmed: newsletter monitoring already exists as a user-added URL feature, so the only defensible angle is breadth of indexed newsletter coverage and discovery, not absence of capability. Contact address is a support inbox, not a named buyer.
